verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's docs show natural-language prompts driving product actions. In the Computer ecosystem, a plain-language request can schedule a recurring task ('run the tests every weekday at 9') or save a procedure as a reusable skill. Agentic mode also lets models act autonomously with tools and sub-agents. However, the evidence centers on the Computer agent workspace, not on operating Open WebUI's own settings, admin, or configuration through natural language. Missing for 10: evidence that core product configuration and administration can be driven by NL commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Run a prompt on a schedule: "run the tests every weekday at 9", "summarize new files every Monday", "check the deploy hourly".
Save this whole procedure as a skill called release-checklist. Include the tag format and the announcement template.
By enabling Native Function Calling (Agentic Mode), you allow quality models to independently explore the web, verify facts, and follow links autonomously.
The AI can delegate work to parallel sub-agents with the delegate_task tool. Each sub-agent is a full chat with tool access
